title: Listener added to a RetryerBuilder after build() is notified by already-built Retryers, including a call already in flight (known #48)
cause: RetryerBuilder keeps one mutable ArrayList of listeners (RetryerBuilder.java:40) and build() hands that same object to every Retryer it builds (RetryerBuilder.java:196 -> Retryer.java:137, no copy); withRetryListener appends to it (RetryerBuilder.java:63) and Retryer.call iterates the live list after every attempt (Retryer.java:166-168). Upstream issue #48 (open, unfixed).
trigger: Public API only: build a Retryer from a builder, then call builder.withRetryListener(L2) - either before the Retryer's next call() (Level 0, one thread) or from another thread while call() is running an attempt (Level 1, MC trace hunt_s3_listeners_bfs2.out: add completes during attempt 1's callable, iterator created afterwards so no CME). JPF also reaches the straddle variant of hunt_sharing_bfs4.out (iterator created between ArrayList.add's modCount++ and its size store).
consequence: The already-built Retryer, including a call() already in flight, invokes L2.onRetry for attempts L2 was never registered for; the set of notified listeners changes between attempts of one call. Per-retryer metrics/audit listeners receive another Retryer's attempts (repro: metricsB counted retryerA's attempts [1, 2] while retryerB never ran). Permanent for the Retryer's lifetime; no removal API.
premises: build() passes the builder's listener ArrayList by reference and neither RetryerBuilder.build() nor the Retryer constructor copies it.
withRetryListener has no built/frozen guard, so application code can keep using the builder after build() (issue #48's template-builder pattern).
No time limiter, fault, or special configuration is needed; the default noTimeLimit/neverStop/noWait setup triggers it.
Retryer is documented as thread-safe (Retryer.java:39-40) and the maintainer endorses sharing one across threads (issue #35); RetryListener is @Beta.
Upstream master is still 177b6c9 and issue #48 is OPEN with no fixing PR (checked 2026-11-26).
